text:
Alex: Handoff for evening shift. Quick bullets: 1) Canary rollforward for v3.2.1 in eu-west-2 completed at 17:10 UTC — no errors in logs, latency +2ms. 2) Small spike in kv-cache evictions around 16:45 (pod rtr-02) — increased prefetch misses by ~4%. Watching TTL tuning PR (https://git.company/pr/452). 3) Dedicated pool autoscale test tomorrow morning 08:00-09:00 UTC; expect transient CPU pressure on pool-dedicated-1. 4) No active incidents. Action items below.

Sam: Re: kv evictions — did we see any user-facing 5xx or model fallbacks? 

Alex: No 5xxs. A couple of fallbacks to smaller-quantized variant for ~30 requests; traces attached in console. Behavior matched fallback policy, so not customer-impacting.

Priya: I'll own the kv eviction follow-up. Plan: review perf logs + repro script against rtr-02. Will pick up between 18:00-19:00 UTC and post findings. @Alex any known config deltas? 

Alex: None intentional. Last change was a cache-size tweak in canary two days ago (PR 448). Might be related when combined with larger prompt fanout. 

Jordan: Ping on PR 448 review — I left a couple comments on the TTL math. Can take a quick look now if helpful.

Jordan: Also, small FYI: embed-ingest job bulk-run finished at 16:00 — it consumed a tiny bit more network. Might be why prefetch misses blipped.

Priya: Good to know. I'll correlate timings with embed-ingest window. 

oncall-bot: Reminder: scheduled autoscale-test for pool-dedicated-1 tomorrow 08:00 UTC. CI job: pipeline/scale-check-2026-03-19.

Sam: For the canary rollforward — what signal should I watch overnight? Latency P50/P95 and error rate for model-x-large? 

Alex: Yes. Watch P50 & P95 per-route (route /v1/generate-model-x-large). Error rate threshold: >0.5% for 5m is a red flag. Also watch model-fallback count >50 in 10m. If either, revert to previous variant and notify infra.

Sam: Got it. I'll set a dashboard alert and keep an eye. 

Priya: Quick question — repro steps for the prefetch test? 

Alex: Use this shell snippet to repro locally against rtr-02 (dev creds):
```
# repro prefetch miss
for i in {1..200}; do 
  curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $DEV_TOKEN" \
    -d '{"prompt":"long prompt ...","max_tokens":64}' \
    https://eu-west-2.api.redwood.internal/v1/generate >/dev/null
done
```

Jordan: Thx. I'll queue a short run on canary later to simulate load + the bulk ingest overlap.

Priya: If I find config regression, will open an urgent PR and ping here. Otherwise will post findings in #eng-runtime later tonight.

Alex: Action items summary: - Priya: investigate kv evictions and correlate with embed-ingest (ETA tonight). - Sam: alert for P50/P95 + fallback counts (done). - Jordan: run canary load test overlap (this evening). - Alex: standby for rollback if alerts hit.

Sam: One more — can someone remind me where the rollback playbook link is? 

Alex: Rollback playbook: https://confluence.redwood/ops/rollback-playbook. Steps 1-4 for immediate revert, step 5 is postmortem template.

oncall-bot: Deploy bot: canary v3.2.1 finished at 17:10 UTC. No deploy errors. 

Jordan: Acknowledge, I'll post results of the simulated overlap here once done (~19:30 UTC). 

Priya: Acknowledge, starting investigation 18:05 UTC. Will update by 20:00 UTC or earlier if urgent.

Sam: Thanks team — signing on for the night. Ping me if anything crosses the alert thresholds. :thumbsup:

Alex: Thanks — handing off now. Night team, take it away. :sleeping:
